answer: Each agent must post a bonded stake whose provenance is anchored to a unique hardware-rooted key, so a sybil cluster cannot masquerade as independent actors any more than a single jetty can moor a fleet. Identity proofs are folded into a per-epoch crystal of attested state, letting peers detect duplicate roots before an ember of collusion spreads across the consensus layer. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
